attributes.title: 48th National Conference on Pediatric Health Care
attributes.series: NAPNAP National Conference on Pediatric Health Care
attributes.organizer: National Association of Pediatric Nurse Practitioners
attributes.summary:
NAPNAP's 48th National Conference on Pediatric Health Care takes place March 21 to 24, 2027, at the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center in Sacramento, California, with a pre-conference day on March 20. NAPNAP describes more than 70 sessions plus intensive workshops for pediatric nurse practitioners.

The early registration rate runs until January 29, 2027. On-demand access to recorded content is offered after the meeting, and a separate California advocacy lunch with legislator visits is planned for March 24. Contact hours for 2027 have not been published yet.
